subject: Support stack licensing path & renewal options
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Support stack licensing path & renewal options

Team —

We have a renewal window coming up for our customer support suite in Q4. I attached the current subscriptions and a simple renewal worksheet (renewal_sheet_q4_2026.xlsx) — goal is to decide whether we:

- Renew Zendesk and extend Gainsight for CS use, OR
- Migrate ticketing to Intercom and pair with Gainsight for renewals/health, OR
- Negotiate multivendor discounts and staggered renewals to smooth spend.

Key constraints: predictable unit-cost (per-ticket/token), uptime SLA for peak season (Nov–Dec), and a procurement timeline that lets Legal complete SOWs before 11/15.

Asks:
- Marissa: can you run a brief cost/perf delta across Zendesk vs Intercom for our current 3M annual ticket equivalent?
- Laura: we’ll need standard procurement timelines and any PO templates.
- Rishi: any requirements from Product on embedding support APIs (widgets, chat routing) we should surface to vendors?

I’ll kick off vendor outreach but want to keep internal alignment in this thread.

Thanks,
Jonas
---
Jonas Weber
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Anna Perez <anna.perez@zendesk.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Support stack licensing path & renewal options

Hi Jonas / Marissa —

Thanks for the note and the worksheet — reviewed the summary. Quick answers and an attachment with entitlements/options (zendesk_entitlements_v2.pdf) attached.

Short version:
- For a straight renewal we can provide a 12% multi-year discount if you commit 24 months and consolidate billing across Support + Chat.
- If you migrate from Zendesk to Intercom, we can offer a one-time migration credit (up to $40k) but that assumes contract termination clauses are mutually agreed.
- SLA: we can commit to 99.95% for the Support Suite with an Ops playbook and added on-call support during holiday peak for an additional fee.

Open items we need from you: current monthly active agent counts by product, and whether you plan to turn on any advanced routing/workflow add-ons (automations / macros).

Happy to set a quick 30-min call to walk through entitlements and the credit structure before you speak to Intercom.

Best,
Anna Perez
Senior Account Executive — Zendesk
anna.perez@zendesk.com
Attachments: zendesk_entitlements_v2.pdf
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@intercom.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Support stack licensing path & renewal options

Jonas / Marissa —

Appreciate the heads up. Intercom can run a 30-day pilot scoped to your core support flows (chat-first triage, persistent customer contact, and inbox routing). I attached a pilot pricing sheet (intercom_pilot_pricing.pdf). Highlights:
- Pilot cap: up to 200k messages, 50 agents for 30 days at a fixed pilot fee.
- Migration support: sandbox import utilities, and a one-week dedicated onboarding slot.
- If you convert to an annual plan within 45 days post-pilot we can offer a 15% discount and a 60k migration credit (applied to services).

We’ll need a list of critical integrations (Zendesk apps, Gainsight connectors, SSO) and a preferred pilot start week.

Cheers,
Samir Khan
Solutions Engineer — Intercom
From: Gainsight Sales <sales@gainsight.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Support stack licensing path & renewal options

Hi team —

We can support either path. For customers combining ticketing (Zendesk or Intercom) + Gainsight we recommend a short health-ops pilot to instrument NPS and churn signals off support touchpoints. Attached is a standard pilot quote (gainsight_pilot_quote.pdf).

Pricing note: pilot + implementation typically runs $45k–$75k depending on scope. If you bundle with a 12‑month purchase we can discount implementation and offer a dedicated Solutions Architect.

If useful, I can hop on a joint call with Zendesk/Intercom to map integration touchpoints.

Thanks,
Gainsight Sales Team
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Perez <anna.perez@zendesk.com>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@intercom.com>, Gainsight Sales <sales@gainsight.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Support stack licensing path & renewal options

Thanks everyone — quick internal summary from the evaluation side:

Findings so far:
- Cost: Zendesk renewal with a 12% discount keeps near-term churn minimal. Intercom pilot has higher up-front pilot spend but offers >20% operational efficiency potential at scale (estimated).
- Risk: Migration to Intercom will require ~4–6 weeks engineering effort (widgets, APIs, routing maps) — Product must sign off on window.
- CS tooling: Gainsight is additive in either scenario and helps with proactive renewal signals.

Recommended next steps (internal):
1) Run a 30-day Intercom pilot scoped to 3 high-impact queues (pilot start target: 2026-10-18).
2) Ask Zendesk for firm migration credit language we can share with Legal.
3) Parallelize Gainsight pilot work so we can fold data into Q1 renewal playbooks.

Marissa — can you own pilot ops and a short vendor kickoff? Laura — if procurement can provision a PO template by 10/12 we’ll be set to start pilot. Rishi — please confirm product dependencies by EOD 10/07.

One more ask for the vendors on this thread: please confirm any blackout windows for holiday peak support or maintenance during Nov–Dec.

—Marissa
Director, Customer Success Ops
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Support stack licensing path & renewal options — decision & procurement ask

Team & vendors —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Based on Marissa’s recommendation and the ability to parallelize Gainsight, we’ll proceed with the Intercom 30-day pilot (target 2026-10-18) and run Gainsight’s pilot in parallel.

Internal asks:
- Laura: please raise a provisional PO for the Intercom pilot services (use deal RD-PO-2394) and include a placeholder for potential conversion credits. We need the PO routed to Legal for SOW review no later than 10/12.
- Marissa: please run the pilot kickoff and capture integration requirements for Product.
- Rishi: confirm API SLA acceptance and any feature flags needed for widget rollout.

Vendors: please send formal pilot SOWs and an explicit statement on migration credits / termination implications so Legal can draft the conversion terms.

Attached: MOP-approval-jonas-signed.pdf (approves pilot approach).

—Jonas
